## 型

### Env

```emela
effect Env
```

The environment variables of the process.

- `fn get(name: String) -> Option[String]`

  `None` if the variable is not set.

### SystemEnv

```emela
handler SystemEnv: Env
uses { ProcessHost }
```

The host's environment variables (JS `process.env`, C `getenv`).
